results.command: tsc --noEmit on scoped reconstructed sources including readiness CLI

iteration_notes: The first CLI process test used a historical fixed approval window and correctly failed; it was corrected to sign against the trusted current test clock rather than weakening expiry enforcement.
limitations: Private HTTPS checkout remains unavailable without a noninteractive Git credential; exact remote blobs plus new sources were tested.
Readiness is intentionally always denied because production reservation/identity/tenant/executor dependencies do not exist.
No paid API, generation, deployment, publication or main merge.
